description: The Digital Atlas of Australia is a national online atlas that gathers Australian Government spatial layers on one ArcGIS platform; the lead agency was not read. The atlas organisation's public item list, read through the ArcGIS search interface on 2026-09-28, holds about 775 public items, 472 of them feature services, among them National Roads, Major Roads, Railway Lines, Power Lines, Australian Operating Mines 2024, National Address Points, National Pollutant Inventory facilities, the Geofabric surface hydrology network and groundwater cartography, near real-time and accumulated bushfire extents, statistical boundaries and many census, income and building approval layers of the Australian Bureau of Statistics. Coverage is Australia. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): set per layer; the layers read (Geoscience Australia, ABS) are CC-BY-4.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: the atlas web pages render by script, so the atlas's own description and curation were not read, and layer dates and completeness vary by source agency. It supports national exposure and network studies, such as overlaying bushfire extents on power lines, roads and railways, or linking infrastructure outages to the populations and addresses served. Related record: the National Roads of Australia layer, catalogued from this atlas.
